items.prompt: A derivative check agrees at h=1e-10and1e-12. What would you still verify?
items.modelAnswer: Check smoothness/domain, one-sided behavior, actual representable increments, finite results, units/scaling, analytic reference and evaluation/noise error. Agreement can be an incorrect plateau or hidden kink, not certification.

criteria.text: Does not equate agreement with correctness.
